note: Partisan-lean prior for polled statewide races. Prior mean = state 2024 presidential margin + (environment - national 2024 margin). Margins are D minus R points.
environment_note: Generic ballot averages were roughly D+7 to D+9 in October 2026 (Silver Bulletin D+8.9 on Oct 7); set slightly below to allow for generic-ballot overstatement. Analyst assumption, not calibrated.
incumbency_note: Points toward the incumbent's party when the incumbent is running (rating open_seat false). Collins won 2020 by 8.6 while Biden won Maine by 9.1 (~18 pt overperformance); override assumes about half persists.
prior_sd_note: Candidate, incumbency and office effects are not modeled explicitly; they live in this spread. Governor races decouple from presidential lean more often, hence wider.
